records.name: The Restless Ghost

requirements.hazard: A level 13 skeleton may be killed or avoided.

outputs: Ghostspeak amulet for later ghost-related content

mechanics.essence: The 50 essence are handed over and are not a permanent requirement.
mechanics.combat: The guardian is immune to Magic; both required enemies can be safespotted or flinched.

records.name: Nature Spirit
records.notes: Self-making a silver sickle normally requires 18 Crafting, a silver bar, and a sickle mould, but 18 Crafting is not a formal quest requirement and must not be encoded as an unconditional hard gate.

records.name: Lost City
outputs: permission to wield dragon daggers and dragon longswords

mechanics.entrana: Weapons and armour cannot be brought to Entrana; an axe can be obtained there from zombies.
mechanics.dramen_staff: A Dramen branch is cut and converted with a knife at 31 Crafting. The untradeable staff is retained and supports later fairy-ring use.

requirements.enemy: Tanglefoot (level 111), damaged only with Magic secateurs

mechanics.random_materials: The quest assigns one contiguous group of three materials from an ordered pool. Inputs vary by account and are consumed when the secateurs are blessed.
mechanics.combat: The Tanglefoot can be flinched; Strength and Farming affect damage but are not formal requirements.

records.name: The Dig Site

in_quest_acquisition_alternatives.opal_or_uncut_opal: A small-chance panning result while seeking the special cup.
in_quest_acquisition_alternatives.charcoal: May be found from the specimen tray, though this can take time.

items_consumed_or_transformed.cup_of_tea: Used on the panning guide to unlock panning.
items_consumed_or_transformed.opal_or_uncut_opal: Given to a student before the level 3 exam.
items_consumed_or_transformed.vial: Filled and carried through the chemical-compound sequence.
items_consumed_or_transformed.charcoal: Ground and used in the chemical compound.

recommended_preparation: Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions.
Fast travel for the Exam Centre, Varrock Museum, and Digsite trips.

museum_certificate_claim.condition: Give the level 3 certificate to Curator Haig Halen after the quest.

conditional_follow_up_unlocks.digsite_pendant_enchanting: After cleaning and showing a clean necklace to a museum archaeologist, ruby necklaces can be enchanted into Digsite pendants with level 49 Magic.

records.notes: Druidic Ritual is normally needed to unlock Herblore training but is not a listed quest prerequisite if the account already has the required Herblore level. The required skill checks are boostable and are not needed to start the quest.

hard_requirements.additional_bone_voyage_requirement: The Dig Site must be complete.

permanent_counter.name: kudos
permanent_counter.mechanic: Kudos can only be acquired and are never spent.

museum_uncleaned_find_displays.access: Requires completion of The Dig Site; its tools can be collected from the museum tool rack.

historian_minas_quest_displays_max.depends_on: Completed eligible quests and their display requirements.

records.name: Bone Voyage

items_consumed.transformation: The Apothecary turns these into the potion of sealegs, which is given to the Lead Navigator.

recommended_preparation: Fast travel to the Digsite, Lumber Yard, Woodcutting Guild, Varrock, and Port Sarim.
For the optional Fossil Island bank chest after completion: 1 iron bar, 2 oak planks, 5 nails, a hammer, and 21 Construction.
permanent_unlocks: Digsite barge Quick-Travel to Fossil Island
records.notes: The redwood-plank barge step has no Woodcutting Guild entry requirement: Berry can sign the sawmill proposal when the player cannot enter the guild.

hard_requirements.facility: Crafting table 2 in a player-owned-house workshop

downstream_birdhouse_cycle.mechanic: A completed birdhouse is dismantled for its clockwork, so four clockworks sustain the four Fossil Island plots. The birdhouse itself is lost.
